nvitk.db.storage
================

.. py:module:: nvitk.db.storage

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Filesystem helpers for the dataset layer: JSON, Parquet, dtype coercion, variable id normalization.

   Shared by the catalog, SQLite index, and import pipelines.

----------

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: utc_now_iso() -> str

   Current UTC timestamp as ISO-8601 string (no microseconds).


.. py:function:: read_json(path: str | pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, Any]

   Load a UTF-8 JSON object from *path*.


.. py:function:: write_json(path: str | pathlib.Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None

   Write *payload* as indented JSON; creates parent directories.

   :value: ('subject_uid', 'visit_id', 'variable_id', 'value_num', 'value_text', 'unit', 'value_kind',...

.. py:data:: MEASUREMENT_TABLE_COLUMNS
   :type:  dict[str, tuple[str, Ellipsis]]

.. py:function:: restrict_to_manifest_columns(df: pandas.DataFrame, allowed_columns: tuple[str, Ellipsis] | list[str]) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Keep only *allowed_columns* present in *df*; drop wide-format ghost columns.


.. py:function:: infer_manifest_dtypes(df: pandas.DataFrame) -> dict[str, str]

   Map column names to dtype strings as stored in table manifests.


.. py:function:: manifest_dtype_to_pandas(dtype_name: str) -> str

   Map manifest dtype strings to pandas dtypes used when coercing frames.


.. py:function:: empty_dataframe(columns: dict[str, str]) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Build an empty DataFrame with columns typed per manifest *columns*.


.. py:function:: coerce_dataframe_to_manifest(df: pandas.DataFrame, columns: dict[str, str]) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Align *df* to manifest columns: ``pipeline_id`` vs ``pipeline_version``, then cast dtypes.


.. py:function:: read_parquet_table(path: str | pathlib.Path, columns: list[str] | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Read Parquet with pyarrow; optional column projection.


.. py:function:: write_parquet_table(path: str | pathlib.Path, df: pandas.DataFrame) -> None

   Write *df* to Parquet (no index); creates parent directories.


.. py:function:: coerce_bool(value: Any) -> bool

   Parse manifest/catalog boolean flags from bool, int, or common string tokens.


.. py:function:: normalize_variable_id(value: str) -> str

   Lowercase snake_case token for matching column names, export names, and UI labels.


.. py:function:: normalize_string(value: Any) -> str | None

   Strip strings; map NaN/empty to None.


.. py:function:: ensure_string_columns(df: pandas.DataFrame, columns: list[str]) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Cast existing *columns* to pandas ``string`` dtype.


.. py:function:: json_dumps(value: Any) -> str

   Stable JSON for hashing or sidecars (sorted keys, ASCII).
